controls.transport: local ipc:// REQ/REP, separate Python process
controls.cache_hit_timer: public getter, CFR copies and cleanup
controls.miss_timer: fresh-cache getter including IPC, decoding and batch insertion

acceptance.coefficient_and_metadata_preservation: bit-exact coefficients; exact dimensions, frequency order, wideband loss and delay for every cached link
acceptance.payload_and_logical_memory: exact Protobuf byte count and 16*L*Nsc*Nrx*Ntx + 4*L*Nsc bytes
acceptance.transport: all raw RTT replies byte-identical to the frozen Wrapper; exactly 27 channel requests (26 at time 0, one at 5000001), one acknowledged close
acceptance.expiry: inclusive end-time hit at 5000000; miss at 5000001
acceptance.repeatability: all deterministic fields and fixture hashes identical across three processes
acceptance.measurements: complete finite positive latency samples and positive RSS/heap snapshots; signed allocator deltas are observations, not hard performance thresholds
